posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina Kaif shared a heartwarming May photo dump with rare glimpses of baby Vihaan Kaushal, including his tiny hands as she read him a story, while also celebrating Vicky Kaushal's 38th birthday.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit Dosanjh continues his massive AURA World Tour with upcoming shows at Crypto.com Arena (LA) and Chase Center (SF), fresh off his global hit 'Ranjha' with Sia and David Guetta.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alia Bhatt's Alpha, the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film, has been preponed to July 3 release — she plays a deadly assassin raised to kill, breaking away from usual spy tropes.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka Chopra confirmed six months of shooting remain for SS Rajamouli's mega-budget Varanasi alongside Mahesh Babu, while also reprising her Krrish role opposite Hrithik Roshan in Krrish 4.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: Shah Rukh Khan's King is locked for Christmas 2026 release — the ₹350 crore action thriller with Suhana Khan, Deepika Padukone, and Abhishek Bachchan is in its final stages of production.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena Kapoor Khan is gearing up for Daayra, a gritty thriller directed by Raazi fame Meghna Gulzar, co-starring Malayalam superstar Prithviraj Sukumaran — promising a raw, intense performance.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha Kapoor is in talks to star opposite Vicky Kaushal in Maddock Films' ambitious mythological drama Mahavatar, where Vicky plays Lord Parashurama — shooting set to begin after June.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika Padukone, expecting her second child with Ranveer Singh, is using a body double for action sequences in Atlee's Raka with Allu Arjun while finishing intense combat scenes for SRK's King.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer Singh is caught in a reported ₹40 crore financial dispute with Don 3 makers while gearing up for new projects — meanwhile, wife Deepika Padukone announced their second pregnancy.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan was named JW Marriott's Global Brand Ambassador and dazzled at Cannes 2026 with daughter Aaradhya, showcasing stunning couture looks including a sculptural 'Luminara' gown.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika Mandanna's Cocktail 2 trailer just dropped — she stars alongside Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon in this summer romance releasing June 19, while also reuniting with Allu Arjun in Atlee's next.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha Ruth Prabhu is producing and starring in Maa Inti Bangaram with Gulshan Devaiah joining the cast — a fierce thriller under her own banner Tralala Moving Pictures, reuniting with Oh! Baby director.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun is shooting Atlee's massive sci-fi epic with Deepika Padukone, Rashmika Mandanna, and Janhvi Kapoor — the parallel-universe film set to be the biggest Indian production ever.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's highly anticipated sports action drama Peddi with Janhvi Kapoor and AR Rahman's music releases in theaters on June 4 — he underwent extensive wrestling training for the role.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR addressed Peddi casting rumors, clarifying he was never planned for the role — meanwhile, his War 2 aftermath continues, with the YRF spy thriller having grossed over ₹168 crore worldwide.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi Kapoor stars opposite Ram Charan in Peddi hitting theaters June 4, while also being part of Allu Arjun and Atlee's massive multi-starrer sci-fi epic currently in production.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya Panday's romantic drama Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya recently released, while she's also filming Call Me Bae Season 2 for Amazon Prime Video — one of the platform's biggest returning franchises.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara Advani's War 2 with Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR released to mixed reviews but crossed ₹168 crore worldwide — she reportedly earned ₹15 crore for the YRF Spy Universe blockbuster.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik Roshan is making his directorial debut with Krrish 4 while War 2 earned him his 8th ₹100 crore film — also confirmed to star alongside Priyanka Chopra in the superhero sequel.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun Dhawan's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with dad David Dhawan releases June 5 — the rom-com also starring Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde promises classic Bollywood family entertainment chaos.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya Ghoshal released the devotional track 'Siddha Bhajo' — her father's favorite song — and is gearing up for The Unstoppable Tour hitting Auckland, Sydney, Melbourne, and 15+ North American cities.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman composed the music for Ram Charan's Peddi releasing June 4 — the sports action drama marks another high-profile Telugu collaboration for the Oscar-winning maestro.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Thalapathy Vijay's Jananayagan is eyeing a post-election release, likely July 2026, after KVN Productions avoided an internal clash with Yash's Toxic which took the June 4 slot.
